subject.title: [Bug]: ${VAR} shell parameter expansion mangles env var values containing ## in Discord channel runtime context

question: Should this security-adjacent Discord exec report stay open for a redacted current-main Docker/Discord reproduction before any code fix or stale close?
rationale: Source inspection and direct shell checks do not reproduce the mutation, but the report involves password-like env data on a stable Discord channel path, so a maintainer needs to decide whether the remaining proof gap merits live reproduction work or cleanup.

options.title: Capture Redacted Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for or run a redacted Docker Discord exec transcript that compares `${VAR}` and `$(printenv VAR)` on current main or the latest release.

options.title: Close As Insufficient
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the missing Discord-bound transcript is enough to treat the old report as stale and request a fresh issue with proof.

options.title: Escalate Security Review
options.body: Route to security triage if maintainers believe credential mutation is plausible enough to investigate without reporter-provided runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Capture Redacted Repro
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for or run a redacted Docker Discord exec transcript that compares `${VAR}` and `$(printenv VAR)` on current main or the latest release.
